```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN num.AcceptedAnswerId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  NULLIF(COUNT(den.Id), 0) AS accepted_rate
FROM main."posts" den
LEFT JOIN main."posts" num 
  ON den."AcceptedAnswerId" = num."Id"
  AND num."PostTypeId" = 2
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', num."CreaionDate") = DATE '2010-12-01'
WHERE den."PostTypeId" = 1
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', den."CreaionDate") = DATE '2010-12-01'
  AND den."CommunityOwnedDate" IS NULL
```
